name: buildment
description: Convenience scripts for the independent frontend and server apps. Root Heroku deploys build the API; deploy the frontend separately.

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir server install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,frontend -c magenta,green "pnpm --dir server dev" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir server build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.heroku-postbuild: pnpm --dir server install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false && pnpm --dir server build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir server test && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir server lint && pnpm --dir frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir server typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
